prompts.cover: Use case: text-localization. Edit supplied original and approved M7-01 cover reference into the next series cover. Preserve deep navy textured background, luminous cyan/green bottom ribbon, lower-left feather emblem, right-aligned large white title, left negative space, overall landscape aspect about 1.805:1. No extra illustrations or diagrams. Bottom-right tagline exactly “一个真实系统七端实战”. Crisp correct Chinese typography. Replace old headline and series line with the specified text; do not retain M0-01 or M7-01. Headline two lines “图片上传” / “完整链路”. Series line “M7-15｜成为全栈·Vue 管理后台篇”.
prompts.upload-pipeline: Use case: infographic-diagram. One landscape Chinese technical blog interior infographic, aspect about 1.805:1. Reference images define the approved series style: deep royal navy blue, clean white Chinese typography, cyan-to-green borders, very subtle luminous bottom ribbon and small feather emblem lower left. Use generous spacing, clear readable short labels, restrained flat cards. Mark with article ID and “示意图”. No fake screenshot, no evidence of passed tests, no checkmarks, no invented brand logos. Only show the specified content. Preserve exact identifiers, correct Chinese. Title “从文件选择到正文引用”. Subtitle “M7-15 · 示意图”. Five short nodes left-to-right “选择 File” → “构造 FormData” → “POST /upload” → “Attachment URL” → “插入 Markdown”. Under last nodes separate note “随后保存文章，正文引用才持久化”. Lower note cards “浏览器生成 boundary” and “多图 Promise.all：全组成功后回调”. Bottom caveat “单张失败时，其他文件可能已上传但未插入正文”. No fake storage proof.
